name: brain-dump
description: Offers to shape a long, loose prompt into a four-part brief (the job, the why, the guardrails, done means), asking up to three questions about real gaps first

min_words.title: Minimum words
min_words.description: Prompts with at least this many words are shaped. Default 120.

ask.title: Ask first
ask.description: on: offer Shape it / Send as is before shaping. off: shape every qualifying prompt straight away.
